description: We have a desire to know more about the survival in the interplanetary system, which helps discovering marks of life to enhancing the chance to develop the background of our technologies to travel in the interplanetary space.
summary: An integrated route map, that helps the astronaut to reach to the destinations safely. Its importance is enhancing the missions of exploration in the future.
details:
Our project does as the following:

The generated map is produced by data coded and AI in software algorithms on the device of the helmet which the astronaut wear. The AI analyze the combination of data between any two selected points then generate the route with its information. If the detector of risk condition detected any high probability of risk, it will alert the astronaut to select another safe path. The benefits of the project is helping the astronauts who will explore Mars in the future, provides safe navigation paths and hazard warnings, increasing the importance of space sector in our society, and advancing national space exploration and geospatial technologies. The impact of our project is providing a valuable tool that save our astronauts who will emigrate faraway from their families and friends to experience the hard condition in space to send to us reliable unique of knowledge, thus we respect their lives !!

- The used software, GoogleColab, AI, python, powerpoint.

- Creativity:

1/Dynamic Routing:Transforms static NASA satellite maps into an interactive, obstacle-avoiding GPS for astronauts.

2/Multi-Layer Fusion: Combines elevation data and high-res canyon imagery to balance safety with scientific discovery

3/Human control design : Simplifies complex Martian planetary data into an intuitive, real-time decision tool.
